(Damage may be canceled)
Needs doing by hand:
  - Your opponent returns the top 10 cards of their stock to their deck, shuffles their deck, puts the same number of cards from the top of their deck into their stock
  - If you put 2 cards into your waiting room, deal 3 damage to your opponent, look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.
